description: DE-Pack: the exempt export to a third country (taxCode AUSFUHR). The `exempt` mechanism has existed since 0.5.0 and the German pack simply had no code using it — a business selling outside the EU had the intra-community supply available and nothing for Switzerland or the United States, which is a different exemption on a different line of the return. Two things distinguish it from `igL`, and both matter. It reports under Kz 43 ("weitere steuerfreie Umsätze mit Vorsteuerabzug", § 4 Nr. 1 Buchst. a in connection with § 6 UStG) rather than Kz 41, and it must NOT appear in the EC sales list — an export to a third country has no acquirer inside the Union to report, and listing one would be a false statement to the tax office rather than a cosmetic error. Note the `createAccount` step: the German pack's chart has an account for exempt intra-community supplies and none for exempt exports, so the tenant adds one — which is what a user has to do today. The pack cannot simply gain the account, because `de-pack-resolves` pins the number of accounts the shipped chart has and the fixtures are append-only (SPEC-013). Here 5,000.00 to a customer outside the EU: no tax line, the base tagged with Kz 43, the return showing 5,000.00 exempt and a payload of 0.00, and the EC sales list staying empty.

result.comment: Steuerfrei: keine Steuerzeile, aber ein Kz-43-Tag an der Basis

expect.comment: Kz 43 statt Kz 41 — eine andere Befreiung auf einer anderen Zeile. Bar bezahlt, weil das de-Pack auf Ist-Versteuerung voreingestellt ist: ohne Zahlung erschiene der Umsatz noch nicht
Kein Erwerber in der Union — eine Meldung hier wäre eine Falschangabe, kein Schönheitsfehler
